locker.key.cutShort: This key is cut short. It starts with pkey_, the product, then 22 characters. Copy the whole key again.

locker.key.space: This key has a space or line break in it. Copy the whole key again in one piece.

locker.key.claimEmail: {product} joins only the account with the license's email verified.
